Exercise 3.1
```{r}
library(vegawidget)
'
{
  "$schema": "https://vega.github.io/schema/vega-lite/v5.json",
  "data": {
    "url": "https://calvin-data304.netlify.app/data/weather-with-dates.csv"
  },
  "width": 800,
  "height": 200,
  "title": "High Temperatures in Seattle by day of the year",
  "transform": [
    {"filter": "datum.location == \'Seattle\'"}
  ],
  "mark": {"type": "line", "color": "indianred"},
  "encoding": {
    "x": {"field": "date", "type": "temporal", "timeUnit": "dayofyear", "title": "Day of the year"},
    "y": {"field": "temp_max", "type": "quantitative", "title": "Max Temperature (°C)"},
    "opacity": {"value": 0.7},
    "color": {"field": "year", "type": "nominal", "title": "Year"}
  }
}' |> as_vegaspec()
```
\

Exercise 3.2

```{r}
library(vegawidget)
'
{
  "$schema": "https://vega.github.io/schema/vega-lite/v5.json",
  "data": {
    "url": "https://calvin-data304.netlify.app/data/weather-with-dates.csv"
  },
  "width": 800,
  "height": 200,
  "title": "Temperatures Distibution in Seattle by month of the year",
  "transform": [
    {"filter": "datum.location == \'Seattle\'"}
  ],
  "mark": {"type": "bar"},
  "encoding": {
    "x": {"field": "month", "type": "ordinal", "timeUnit": "month", "title": "Month of the year"},
    "y": {"field": "temp_max", "type": "quantitative", "title": "Max Temperature (°C)"},
    "opacity": {"value": 0.7},
    "color": {"field": "weather", "type": "nominal", "title": "Weather"}
  }
}' |> as_vegaspec()
```
